Container.Name: unraid-gateway
Container.Overview: Single authenticated HTTPS port for mobile clients: a streaming file API over your shares (list, download with Range, resumable upload, move/copy/delete, change feed for iOS File Provider) plus a proxy to the Unraid GraphQL API and a small web UI to test it from a browser. Authentication uses your Unraid API key (Settings > Management Access > API Keys), optionally plus an Unraid user and password: the user then gets exactly the share permissions configured in Unraid (public / secure / private, read and write lists), verified against the Unraid SMB service. Run behind a reverse proxy with a valid certificate (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG) or Cloudflare Tunnel. Mount only the shares you want reachable from your phone: documents, media and downloads are preconfigured, add any other share as an extra Path under /data/<name>. Do not map Time Machine shares.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-09-09 (v0.5.0) - Persistent item index (SQLite in /config): stable ids per file, change journal, instant `/fs/changes?seq=` feed, `/fs/item?id=`; background scanner (directory scan every 5 min, full scan every 6 h). Mount /mnt/user/appdata/unraid-gateway to /config.
### 2026-09-09 (v0.4.0) - Readable text logs by default (LOG_FORMAT/LOG_LEVEL/LOG_HEALTHCHECKS), start-up banner, console walkthrough (`gw` command).
### 2026-09-08 (v0.3.x) - Per-user access: Unraid username and password verified over SMB, share permissions (public/secure/private, read and write lists) applied as in Unraid; shares are the real container mounts.
### 2026-09-08 (v0.2.x) - Paginated change feed for large shares, immutable share roots, resumable uploads, web UI.
### 2026-09-08 (v0.1.0) - First release.
Container.Requires: An Unraid API key (Settings > Management Access > API Keys). For remote access, a reverse proxy with a valid TLS certificate or Cloudflare Tunnel in front of the gateway port.

Config.Name: Gateway port
Config.Description: Port exposed by the gateway. Put a reverse proxy with TLS in front of it before exposing it to the Internet.

Config.Name: Unraid WebGUI URL
Config.Description: LAN URL of your Unraid WebGUI, used to validate API keys and proxy GraphQL. Use the server IP, not localhost.

Config.Name: documents share
Config.Description: Each mapped share appears as a top-level folder in the Files app. Add more shares with 'Add another Path' (container path /data/<name>); set Access Mode to Read Only for shares you only want to browse.

Config.Name: Gateway data (item index)
Config.Description: Small SQLite catalogue of your files (stable ids, change journal) so the app syncs instantly instead of walking the shares. Safe to delete: it is rebuilt at start.

Config.Name: Unraid share security (read-only)
Config.Description: The share definitions Unraid generates for Samba (public/secure/private, read and write user lists). Needed so that users logging in with their Unraid username and password get exactly the permissions they have over SMB.

Config.Name: User authentication
Config.Description: optional: clients may add an Unraid username and password to the API key and get that user's share permissions; required: every client must; off: API key only (access = container mounts).

Config.Name: Unraid SMB address
Config.Description: host:port of the Unraid SMB service used to verify user passwords. Empty = host of the WebGUI URL, port 445.

Config.Name: Read-only mode
Config.Description: true disables every write operation on all mapped shares.

Config.Name: Session lifetime
Config.Description: How long a login token stays valid (Go duration: 30m, 12h, 168h).

Config.Name: Max login attempts
Config.Description: Failed logins per IP before a temporary lockout.

Config.Name: Login lockout
Config.Description: Lockout duration after too many failed logins.

Config.Name: Trust proxy headers
Config.Description: true when behind Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG or Cloudflare Tunnel, so rate limiting sees the real client IP.

Config.Name: Unraid self-signed TLS
Config.Description: true only if UNRAID_URL is https with a self-signed certificate.

Config.Name: Validation query
Config.Description: GraphQL query used to validate API keys. Change only if your Unraid version lacks the 'me' field.

Config.Name: Index directory scan
Config.Description: How often directories are checked for changes made outside the gateway (SMB, other containers). Only directories are stat'ed.

Config.Name: Index full scan
Config.Description: How often every file is re-checked (catches content edits that leave the folder date untouched).

Config.Name: Change feed page deadline
Config.Description: Max time per /fs/changes page. Large shares on shfs scan at roughly 3000 entries per second; clients page with after=next.
